options.rationale: Fallback for any set with no smear and no tissue report. A lone IHC, Gene, Lab or imaging report falls here and is understated, which is the safe direction.

options.rationale: Catches every set with a smear or trephine report that does not reach the rungs of options 2 to 4, including immunocytochemistry (Cytology plus IHC Report with no Histology Report), a trephine without IHC, and genetics without the full ladder. Excluding IHC or genetics would dead-end those sets, and the tick rules cannot express 'not all of the three'. Complete files also fit this option, so the clerk is asked between this option and the higher rung that fits.

options.label_head: Bone marrow aspirate (BMA) + trephine biopsy with IHC (CD61 / CD41 per
options.rationale: The label names the aspirate, the trephine and the IHC, so all three documents are required (standing rule 8, rule c). Cytology plus IHC Report with no Histology Report is immunocytochemistry and must not reach a tissue tier (rule d), so Proposer B's any_of lift is rejected. Genetics is excluded so files with a Gene report fit options 3 and 4 instead.

options.rationale: Every rung the label names is required: aspirate, trephine, IHC and a Gene report. Genetics without the trephine and IHC rungs falls to option 1, which understates. Same fit set as option 4 because one Gene report cannot say which tests were done.
